name: Willow Family Care
description: A welcoming neighborhood practice with flexible examination rooms and a dedicated patient support team.

accessible_parking.detail: Two designated spaces with adjacent access aisles by the main entrance.

written_communication.detail: Staff can use a tablet or written notes throughout the visit.

visual_alerts.detail: A visual appointment display and flashing emergency alerts are available.

screen_reader_forms.detail: Digital intake forms have labeled controls and have been tested with screen readers in this fictional scenario.

large_print.detail: 18-point large-print intake and care materials are available on request.

staff_assistance.detail: Staff can assist with wayfinding and read forms aloud on request.

quiet_waiting.detail: A separate quiet waiting room can be requested when booking.

reduced_lighting.detail: No reviewed information is available for this accommodation. Confirmation is needed.

low_stimulation.detail: A care room without background music or screens can be reserved.

language_interpretation.detail: Remote spoken-language interpretation is offered; request your language in advance.

alternative_communication.detail: Staff allow extra time and support patient-provided AAC devices and communication boards.
